entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight and heir to the Legacy.

entities.name: Starke

entities.description: Weatherlight navigator educated at the Argivian University.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Cat warrior of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin cabin hand of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem who mourns a death he caused.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A cursed noble who joins the Weatherlight, whose family has been killed.

entities.name: Maraxus
entities.description: Chaotic warlord of Keld who has no master.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Teacher of Ertai on Tolaria.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker whose actions Ertai questions.

entities.description: Author of The Lonely Giant.

entities.description: A friend of Squee who loved storms.

entities.name: Lord of the Wastes
entities.description: A foe whom Sisay believes must be destroyed.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The ship crewed by Gerrard, Sisay, Mirri and others.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Island that floats upon a wheel of fortune.

entities.name: Avenant
entities.description: An island that cannot be approached with archers or ballistae.

entities.name: Llanowar

entities.description: University that taught Hanna to look to the past.

entities.name: Benalish army
entities.description: Army in which Gerrard served.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Land of curses.

entities.name: Aboroth

entities.name: Thran Forge
entities.description: A forge Gerrard uses to strengthen the aboroth.

entities.name: Vodalian
entities.description: Fishtails (merfolk) who are hard to approach.

entities.name: Talruum
entities.description: Minotaurs who trade taunts.

entities.name: Elves of Llanowar
entities.description: Elves whose forest is their best protector.

events.summary: Starke lies to Gerrard that he had to kill, and pledges loyalty.
events.quote: "I killed him because I had to," Starke lied to Gerrard. "But now I pledge my loyalty to you."

events.summary: Starke pleads to be saved from Maraxus or condemned to his wrath.
events.quote: "Save me from Maraxus," Starke pleaded, "or condemn me to his wrath. Either way, do not ignore me!"

events.summary: Mirri resists the urge to kill Ertai as he boasts.
events.quote: Mirri's hackles rose as Ertai continued expounding his virtues.

events.summary: Tahngarth eyes Squee as bait to trap Avizoa.
events.quote: "Maybe we can trap them with bait," thought Tahngarth, eyeing Squee.

events.summary: Sisay declares the Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed.
events.quote: "The Lord of the Wastes must be destroyed; I am bound to this destiny by the chains of fate. If only Gerrard would see his part."

events.summary: Squee whines about the goats that would fly.
events.quote: "But you *said* 'when goats fly!'" Squee whined.

events.summary: Karn mourns an innocent man who died due to his anger.
events.quote: "An innocent man died because of my anger. That knowledge will haunt me for all eternity."

events.summary: Crovax recounts his family being killed and ancestors fed on.
events.quote: "They killed my family to deny me a future. They fed on my ancestors to deny me a past."

events.summary: Crovax accepts a place aboard the Weatherlight, leaving his rotting family.
events.quote: "You must be mad to want one such as I aboard the *Weatherlight*. But I would be mad to remain here with my rotting family. I accept."

events.summary: Crovax says he was damned to solitude after refusing to barter his soul.
events.quote: So they took it from me and damned me to solitude."

events.summary: Gerrard threatens a gatekeeper to pass the gate.
events.quote: "There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious."

events.summary: Squee remembers Glok who loved storms.
events.quote: "Glok loved storms! He'd sit an' watch an' laugh through the whole thing. I miss him."

events.summary: Squee realizes he is not the dumb one among the goblin grenadiers.
events.quote: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

events.summary: Maraxus threatens Starke as a traitor.
events.quote: "Stroke of heat or stroke of blade. Choose your fate, traitor."

events.summary: Maraxus declares he has no master.
events.quote: "I have no master. I am chaos."

events.summary: Maraxus promises his ogres they will sharpen their teeth on enemies' bones.
events.quote: "You will sharpen your teeth on my enemies' bones," Maraxus promised them, and his ogres cheered.

events.summary: The Weatherlight banks as an aboroth rises to crush a lone rider.
events.quote: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider.

events.summary: Mirri lays a wreath for her fallen kin.
events.quote: "I place this wreath for you, my kin. Even in death, you give me strength to avenge you."

events.summary: Squee fears the forest is thinking about dinner too.
events.quote: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

events.summary: Gerrard uses the Thran Forge to strengthen the aboroth, calling out to the elves.
events.quote: "This will work," Gerrard called to the elves as he used the forge to strengthen the aboroth, "but if it doesn't, we won't survive to care."

events.summary: Karn says a sidar's son turned him to a statue with a touch of the stone.
events.quote: "One touch to the stone and the sidar's son turned me from stalwart to statue."

events.summary: Karn vows not to take another's life though he would die for Gerrard.
events.quote: "Although I would give my life to protect Gerrard, my conscience will not let me take another's. There are many who would not hesitate."

events.summary: Ertai questions what Teferi thought he was doing.
events.quote: "I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"

events.summary: Hanna describes the king's artificer who was also his jester.
events.quote: Unfortunately, the royal artificer was also the king's jester."

events.summary: Gerrard says he sneezed and a drake bolted.
events.quote: "I sneezed, and it bolted."
